About

What this is. A ledger of every wallet in OnRe’s points programme: where the points come from, who holds them, and what each wallet earns per day. Built from OnRe’s public data and refreshed every hour.

How rates are measured. Each wallet’s daily rate is its gain between snapshots up to four days apart, divided by the real time between them. Points post in batches, so an active wallet can briefly read zero.

Projections and airdrop estimates are arithmetic on today’s numbers, not forecasts. OnRe hasn’t announced a token or an airdrop.

.sol names are looked up with the public Solana Name Service (sns.id).

Visits are counted with Vercel Web Analytics: anonymous page views, no cookies, nothing that identifies you.
